about: SCION 05 Norstein: what the dog did, measured per scene frame from the render (torso and head ID passes, silhouette; facing from where the cut nose piece lies against the skull piece). x_score = x_world_measured: the torso pass centroid unprojected at the dog glass depth (metres, same axis as the score). state is classified from measurements (facing, speed, head above or below the back line, silhouette height); state_score is the score state that drove the acting.
